checkerSemantics: token comparison; unique answer per statement review; expected outputs from authored reference agree with the independent oracle on every test

inputConstraints.rules: n in [1,1000], 0<=p<=n, pipes a b d (a!=b, d in [1,1e6]), indeg/outdeg <= 1
inputConstraints.upstreamContradictions: none: every supplied official/open-r1 pair passed both validators; candidates with invalid upstream pairs are quarantined
inputConstraints.validator: strict authored validator probs_e.P107A.V filters every authored input; independent oracle re-validates every official/open-r1/authored/sample input and exits 1 on violation

statementComplete: statement/input/output/examples present in pinned open-r1/codeforces row (row_gate passed); reviewed by worker and by independent oracle author
